complexDefinition.stringValue: The process of devoting time and attention to gaining knowledge of an academic subject, especially by means of books.

definition.stringValue: The act of spending time to learn about something, often through reading.

text.stringValue: Действие, связанное с тратой времени на изучение чего-либо, часто посредством чтения.
**Study** of foreign languages requires investing numerous hours.
The **study** of mathematics improves logical thinking.
Einstein's **study** of physics revolutionized our understanding of the universe.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

definition.stringValue: An in-depth look into a subject or situation.

text.stringValue: Глубокое изучение темы или ситуации.
**Study** revealed insights into ancient Egyptian architecture.
The medical **study** focuses on Alzheimer's disease progression.
A comprehensive **study** on artificial intelligence revolutionized robotics.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A room used or designed for reading, writing, or academic work.

definition.stringValue: A room meant for reading or doing work.

text.stringValue: Комната, предназначенная для чтения или работы.
**Study** is where I spend most of my afternoons reading.
Show me the **study**, I have a lot of paperwork to do.
Your **study** is such a peaceful and quiet place.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A piece of research that examines a subject in detail and usually over a long period of time, especially in order to discover new information or reach a new understanding.

definition.stringValue: A deep, long-term investigation of a subject to discover new information.

text.stringValue: Глубокое, долгосрочное исследование предмета с целью обнаружения новой информации.
**Study** of ancient manuscripts reveals insights on medieval societies.
Her groundbreaking **study** revolutionized our understanding of genetic diseases.
A nationwide **study** on childhood obesity was conducted recently.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A representation in literature or art of inanimate objects or a view for its aesthetic value.

definition.stringValue: A depiction of objects or a view in literature or art for their beauty.

text.stringValue: Изображение объектов или видов в литературе или искусстве по их красоте.
**Study** of Monet's water lilies captivated the audience completely.
Renoir's **study** of the bustling Parisian café life is outstanding.
Jerome's **study** of dreaming minds in blackout was captivating.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A published report giving information about a particular matter or subject.

definition.stringValue: A published report on a specific matter or subject.

text.stringValue: Опубликованный отчет по конкретному вопросу или теме.
**Study** on depression revealed alarming new trends.
A **study** uncovered the benefits of regular exercise.
Their **study** examined the effects of poor diet in adolescents.

complexDefinition.stringValue: An artwork or piece of music devoted to the representation or analysis of a particular subject.

definition.stringValue: A piece of art or music that represents or analyzes a subject.

text.stringValue: Произведение искусства или музыки, которое представляет или анализирует определенную тему.
**Study** of the human form inspired Michelangelo's masterpiece.
The composer's prelude is a musical **study** in emotional expression.
She appreciated the intricate **study** of colors in Van Gogh's work.

complexDefinition.stringValue: A written work giving information about a particular subject.

definition.stringValue: A written report about a certain subject.

text.stringValue: Письменный отчет на определенную тему.
**Study** shows correlation between diet and heart disease.
Latest **study** reveals advancements in renewable energy technologies.
New **study** published on the effects of meditation on anxiety.

complexDefinition.stringValue: In musical terminology, study is a short piece designed to provide practice material for perfecting a particular technical skill.

definition.stringValue: In music, a short piece to practice a specific technical skill.

text.stringValue: В музыке это короткая пьеса для отработки конкретного технического навыка.
**Study** in B flat major improved her arpeggio technique.
He was practicing a demanding Bach **study** for violin.
The pianist battled through a challenging Rachmaninoff **study**.

complexDefinition.stringValue: In printing, an impression from type, taken for correction or examination.

definition.stringValue: In printing, a print from type, taken for checking or reviewing.

text.stringValue: В полиграфии это отпечаток с набора, полученный для проверки или рассмотрения.
**The study** revealed minor misprints in the publication.
She proofread the manuscript thoroughly after examining the **study**.
The final draft was approved after scrutinizing the **study**.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To apply one's mind purposefully to the acquisition of knowledge or understanding of a subject.

definition.stringValue: To intentionally learn about a subject or idea.

text.stringValue: Специально изучать тему или идею.
**Study** the rules before playing the game.
She decided to **study** advanced mathematics in college.
The doctor had to **study** the patient's medical history thoroughly.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To examine something in detail, as for purposes of analysis, criticism, interpretation, etc.

definition.stringValue: To examine something closely, often for review or analysis.

text.stringValue: Изучать что-то внимательно, часто для обзора или анализа.
**Study** the map before you start your journey.
You need to **study** for your mathematics exam tomorrow.
The police will **study** the CCTV footage for clues.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To think deeply about something, ponder.

definition.stringValue: To think a lot about something.

text.stringValue: Много думать о чем-то.
**Study** this piece before drawing your own conclusions.
She needs to **study** the implications of this decision.
I will **study** the varying dimensions of cultural difference.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To review materials already learned in order to make sure one does not forget them.

definition.stringValue: To review something one has learned so they don't forget it.

text.stringValue: Пересматривать что-то, что было выучено, чтобы этого не забыть.
**Study** for your math test tomorrow.
We should **study** our notes after every lecture.
I'll **study** my Spanish vocabulary tonight.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To contemplate (something) as a subject for an artwork, literature or academic work.

definition.stringValue: To think about something as a subject for an artwork or a research work.

text.stringValue: Размышлять о чем-либо как о предмете для произведения искусства или исследовательской работы.
**Study** these sculptures for your art history thesis.
She will **study** the culture of ancient Mesopotamia for her dissertation.
Photographers often **study** their subjects before taking pictures.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To commit significant information to memory.

text.stringValue: Запоминать важную информацию.
**Study** this map to find the quickest route home.
Before the exam, I'd better **study** these algebra formulas.
To pass the medical license test, she must **study** anatomy.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To enroll in a course, program, or school.

definition.stringValue: To sign up for a course, program, or school.

text.stringValue: Записаться на курс, программу или в школу.
**Lisa decided to study** psychology at Harvard University.
I plan to **study** Medicine at Oxford University next year.
After high school, he wants to **study** biology at Yale University.

complexDefinition.stringValue: In theater, to rehearse and learn the part of a role.

definition.stringValue: In theater, to learn and practice a role.

text.stringValue: В театре изучать и отрабатывать роль.
**Study** your lines for tomorrow's rehearsal.
I have to **study** my part for the upcoming performance.
He needs to **study** his role for the play's premiere.
